{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "A slot the description says is not needed is not an item: give it worn false. One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note; then items is empty."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A fine-gauge wool blend turtleneck in heathered charcoal (#3f4f5d), relaxed fit with dropped shoulders and a length hitting mid-hip.
High-waisted straight-leg trousers in dark washed denim (#2b2b2b), classic five-pocket silhouette with a slight taper at the ankle for easy movement.
A structured blazer in a matte cotton twill in deep forest green (#1e3a30), notched lapels and single-button closure that adds polish without bulk.
Leather loafers in chestnut brown (#8c5e3f), penny detail with a low block heel for comfort during extensive walking.
Thin wool scarf in oatmeal (#d7cba9) and minimal gold stud earrings in 14k yellow gold (#f2daa0).
This outfit works because it respects the "neat" dress code while accommodating her strong wish to walk a lot with non-restrictive cuts and flexible fabrics. The color palette of charcoal, forest green, and chestnut creates a sophisticated yet relaxed look that fits the evening artificial lighting of a club without feeling overly formal. It balances her desire for a classic silhouette with the practical need for comfort during extended movement at a rock concert in autumn."}
